# Retrospective remaining-test capture

This curated record was assembled after the actual normal run finished. It preserves the original 79 source bytes, including literal CR/CRLF and trailing spaces, and the full unsuccessful run without rewriting histories. It is not a pre-run archive, a source repair, or a new command execution.

[The source index](source-index.json) binds each separate input to its frozen author packet, original Git driver and stated reach. [The terminal report](reports/terminal-bindings.json) binds all 35 failed tests to exact complete panic blocks in the single lossless stdout archive. The 128 harness result lines are a focused projection, not 128 successful runs. Complete driver input maps are stored once in its gzip archive rather than copied into every observation.

The normal run used HEAD477 and whole-working aaa5, which already contained the earlier axis/mixed test repairs. That dirty source epoch is distinct from clean Git477 and all later repair/retention epochs. Compiler, kernel, observed CLI, full input maps and before/after stability are actual recorded data. The observed CLI hash does not attest a fresh standalone CLI build. An unsuccessful command does not establish a zero-conditional-skip claim for the whole run.

[The environment-only retry](observations-after/process-tree-environment.json) is an actual separate one-test unsandboxed process check. Its 4.02s test duration and driver wall duration are distinct. It changes no source and provides no semantic repair or full library/MSRV/CI evidence. Original ps permission failure bytes remain in the BEFORE archive.

All gzip files are inert archival storage, assembled with mtime0 and exact decoded byte equality. The existing authoring reader validates format/source hashes and report/observation presence; it does not decode gzip, replay these commands or prove preservation. External independent archival review and root fixture/staged-blob checks provide the separate exact-byte checks. No reader, checker or schema changes are introduced.

Existing second-loop variants and historical sources are preserved without claiming execution. Desired repair controls and new maximum-size quantum cases are excluded. The original 16-file [earlier session](../ordinary-primitive-ci-followup-v030/session.json) remains byte-identical. Semantic AFTER summaries may later be appended as separate focused records with their actual changed working epoch; they must not rewrite this BEFORE or claim same-commit CI. No such future result exists here.

No native acceptance rule, tolerance, cap, dependency, guarantee, adoption or issue status is changed by archival storage. Independent exact Meaning, full phase, axis, owner/reference and source-binding obligations remain in the repaired tests and actual future validation.
